title: Smart Data Models - ERA ERADIS - Certificate
description: Certificate (era:Certificate's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Base class for those Certificates in the ERADIS register, which allow a IOD/SD described process. Inherits attributes from era:Permission (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Certificate'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

areaOfOperation.description: Property. (33) ‘area of operation’ means a network or networks within one or more Member States where a railway undertaking intends to operate.; Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

borderPointStation.description: Relationship. Link a certificate to the border station for operations Target type (OperationalPoint/ReferenceBorderPoint) is published under the era-rinf standard.

coversDangerousGoods.description: Property. Covers for a `type of operation` involving the freight transport of dangerous goods

coversHighSpeed.description: Property. Covers for `type of operation` of passenger transport services at speeds higher than 250km/h, or speeds considered as such through TEN-T.

coversOnlyShunting.description: Property. Covers for a `type of operation` limited to only shunting operations

relatedCertificate.description: Property. Identification number of a related Certificate.

transportationVolumeFreight.description: Property. The transportation volume for freight services.

transportationVolumePassenger.description: Property. The transportation volume for passenger services.

vehicleTypeCategory.description: Property. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Vehicle Categories' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/vehicle-types/Categories), 4 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

vehicleTypeSubCategory.description: Property. Indicates the further classification (but not any family/platform) of vehicles within a vehicle category. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Vehicle Sub Categories' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/vehicle-types/SubCategories), 26 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

permissionStatus.description: Property. the status of the Permission, from a controlled Vocabulary, expressing how it evolves from being drafted to being valid and eventually possibly revoked/withdrawn. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

permits.description: Property. the process, activity, role or other scope which the Permission allows to the Requesting Body to execute or hold Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from the relevant ERA code list (see era-skos), not enumerated here as the source ontology leaves this range open.

requestedIn.description: Relationship. aiming to be enabled to act as covered by the Permission and its conditions, by issuing Target type (Request) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

submittedIn.description: Relationship. The submission of a permission or evidence to a case Target type (Case) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

valid.description: Relationship. valid during a certain time Target type (Interval) is not published as its own SDM model yet.
